title: Power Loss Estimation for PV Modules with Cracked Cells
mechanism: Crack, dark and busbar masks are compressed into a VAE latent, and XGBoost predicts per-cell power loss (the pvcracks pipeline).
adaptation: Bold benchmark option: once their cell EL + I-V data is released (listed as pending), feed our masks to their power model and score segmenters by I-V agreement. Reference only until then.
min_experiment: When the data is available: per-cell dPmpp MAE using masks from the house, PF and ensemble models. Kill if the spread between models is below the model's own error.
evidence: R: per the web docs, XGBoost per-cell dPmpp; numbers not retrieved (full text fetch timed out).
